summary: Frontend-only test of the clean console redesign and the new landing tile. Everything requested passed. Landing /cloudivr: usecase-texting tile shows inside usecases-grid with the Landline to Texting heading and $300/$500/$50/month/$0.05; usecase-texting-link goes to /cloudivr/signup; the telegram tile still shows. Layout: 4+2 / 2+2+2 / 3+3 bento on 1920, single column with no overflow on 390. In-app sidebar is navy rgb(11,21,51) in both themes. Nav text rgb(201,209,232), active link white on rgb(21,35,75) with a border, group labels rgb(127,138,176). topbar-theme-button toggles the theme and saves it to localStorage civr.theme. Light mode: white page, DM Sans 32px titles, blue rgb(47,84,235) primary buttons, thin-border cards. Dark mode looks coherent with primary rgb(61,99,242). Empty states (Bob contacts, Bob numbers, Alice texting) show the dashed empty-art (2px dashed, 104px) with the + badge, title, sub and buttons. Swept 12 pages (Overview, Numbers, Buy, Texting, Live, Contacts, Campaigns, AI agents, Wallet, Inbox, Settings, Help) plus Alice's number detail page in both themes: 0 page errors, 0 low-contrast text (heuristic contrast < 2.5), no horizontal overflow. Number-detail and AI-agent tabs use underline style: the selected tab is blue with a 2px bottom border, and tab switching works. Mobile 390: sidebar hidden, mobile-bottom-nav shown, scrollWidth 390 on all checked pages.

issues: body background computes to white in dark mode (theme-clean only sets body for light). The .civr wrapper paints dark so nothing visible, but overscroll or rubber-band areas may flash white. Consider html[data-civr-theme=dark] body { background: var(--c-bg) }. Low priority.

action_items: Optional: set the dark-mode body background to match --c-bg
critical_code_review_comments: theme-clean.css is overrides keyed on Tailwind arbitrary-value class names (e.g. .text-\[\#818cf8\]). This is brittle: any new indigo shade or opacity variant will not follow the new accent. Over time, move components to CSS vars.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use wait_until=domcontentloaded (networkidle times out because of polling). Dismiss cookie-allow-all before logging in. Alice's number is +13346972125. Theme is set with localStorage civr.theme. On the landing page the tile label is CSS-uppercased, so inner_text returns 'LANDLINE TO TEXTING'.
